The management of Yivi has recently been transferred to another organization ([Yivi B.V.](https://yivi.app/en/about_yivi)).

Therefore, the terms and conditions have changed slightly.

We ask you to [read them]({terms_url}) and agree to them below.

yivi.title: Yivi support can help you further
yivi.body: Send us an email. We will answer as soon as we can.
yivi.mail_prompt: Describe your question or problem here:

context.activity_disclosure_note: Yivi only passed on your data. What happens next, such as the outcome of your request, is up to {org}.

arrange.title: I need to arrange something with an organization
arrange.subtitle: Such as requesting your claim-free years or logging in
arrange.lead: You arrange that on the website of {org}, not in Yivi. Yivi stores your data and passes it on when you approve.
arrange.step_1: Go to the website of {org} and start your request there.
arrange.step_2: Choose Yivi on the website. The app opens by itself, or you scan a QR code.
arrange.step_3: Check which data is requested and approve sharing it.
arrange.step_4: Your request is then handled by {org}, who will tell you what happens next.
arrange.note: Missing data? While sharing, Yivi shows which data you still need to add, and how.
arrange.handover: Only {org} can look into your request and help you further. Yivi can't.

outcome.title: I'm waiting for an outcome
outcome.subtitle: You shared your data, but haven't heard anything
outcome.lead: The outcome comes from {org}, not from Yivi. Yivi only passes on your data and doesn't see what happens next.
outcome.step_1: Check your email and the website of {org}. That is where the outcome will appear.
outcome.step_2: Want to know what you shared and when? You can find that under Activity.
outcome.note: How long it takes is up to {org}.
outcome.handover: Only {org} can look into your request and help you further. Yivi can't.

add_data.title: Adding data doesn't work
add_data.subtitle: Email address, phone number, passport or ID card
add_data.lead: Yivi issues this data itself. This usually fixes it:
add_data.step_1: Make sure you have the latest version of Yivi.
add_data.step_2: No email or text message? Check your spam folder and the address or number you entered.
add_data.step_3: Passport or ID card: take your phone out of its case and hold it still against the document.
add_data.note: Getting data from an organization other than Yivi? Then that organization can help you.

ask.title: Where do you get the data from?
ask.app_subtitle: Email address, phone number, passport or ID card
ask.choose_body: Choose the organization you get the data from. They can see why it doesn't work and help you further. Yivi can't.

data_wrong.title: My data is incorrect
data_wrong.subtitle: A name, address or other detail is wrong or outdated
data_wrong.lead: Yivi copies your data from the source and can't change it. Have it changed at the source, then obtain it again.
data_wrong.step_1: Personal details and address come from your municipality. Have them changed there.
data_wrong.step_2: New email address or phone number? Add the new one in Yivi.
data_wrong.step_3: Changed? Open the data in Yivi and choose Reobtain.
data_wrong.handover: Changed at the source, but still incorrect after obtaining it again? Then Yivi can help you further.

pin.title: Forgot my PIN or the app is blocked
pin.lead: Nobody knows your PIN, not even Yivi. So we can't reset it for you.
pin.step_1: Choose “I forgot my PIN” on the PIN screen.
pin.step_2: Start over: choose a new PIN and add your data again.
pin.step_3: Is your app blocked? Reinstall Yivi and start over.

phone.title: New phone or lost phone
phone.lead: Your data is only stored on your phone. There is no backup and no cloud.
phone.step_1: New phone: install Yivi and add your data again.
phone.step_2: Lost phone: without your PIN nobody can get into your Yivi app.
phone.step_3: Did you add your email address? Then you can block the app remotely via MyYivi.

app_broken.title: The app doesn't work or shows an error
app_broken.step_1: Check your internet connection. Yivi doesn't work without one.
app_broken.step_2: Make sure you have the latest version of Yivi.
app_broken.step_3: Close the app completely and open it again.
app_broken.note: Did you get an error message? Choose “Need help?” there, and we'll send the error report along.

data_from_organisation.title: Question about your data from {org}
data_from_organisation.lead: This data comes from {org}. Yivi only stores it and can't change it.
data_from_organisation.step_1: Something incorrect? Have it changed at {org}.
data_from_organisation.step_2: Then open the data in Yivi and choose Reobtain.
data_from_organisation.handover: Only {org} can look into and change your data. Yivi can't.

error_yivi.title: Error in the Yivi app
error_yivi.lead: This error is in Yivi itself, not at {org}.
error_yivi.step_1: Make sure you have the latest version of Yivi.
error_yivi.step_2: Try again in a few minutes from the website of {org}.
error_yivi.handover: Yivi will look at your error report and help you further.

error_organisation.title: Error at {org}
error_organisation.lead: Something went wrong at {org}, not in your Yivi app.
error_organisation.step_1: Try again later from the website of {org}.
error_organisation.handover: This can only be solved by {org}. Yivi has no access to their systems.

error_unknown.title: Something went wrong
error_unknown.lead: From this error we can't tell whether the cause is the app or {org}. That's why Yivi looks first.
error_unknown.step_2: Make sure you have the latest version of Yivi.
error_unknown.step_3: Try again from the website of {org}.
error_unknown.handover: Yivi will look at your error report and find out where it went wrong. If it turns out to be at {org}, we'll let you know.

error_expired.title: The session has expired
error_expired.lead: That happens when it took a while, or when you used an old link or QR code.
error_expired.step_1: Go back to the website of {org}.
error_expired.step_2: Start again there and finish in one go.
error_expired.handover: Does the session keep expiring? Then Yivi will find out what goes wrong.

device_lock_required.title: Set a screen lock
device_lock_required.explanation_android:
Your phone has no screen lock. Yivi protects your data with your phone's security, so it only works on a phone with a screen lock: a PIN, pattern or password, which fingerprint and face unlock also use.

Set a screen lock in your phone's settings, then come back to Yivi.
device_lock_required.explanation_ios:
Your iPhone has no passcode. Yivi protects your data with your iPhone's security, so it only works on an iPhone with a passcode, which Face ID and Touch ID also use.

Set a passcode in Settings, under Face ID & Passcode (or Touch ID & Passcode), then come back to Yivi.

app_integrity_blocked.title: Yivi cannot be used right now
app_integrity_blocked.explanation:
Yivi noticed a tool that can inspect or change the app while it is running, such as a debugger. To protect your data, Yivi stays closed for as long as that tool is active.

Close the tool or restart your phone, then open Yivi again.

privacy_screen.capture_cover: Yivi is hidden while your screen is being recorded or shared.

rooted_warning.title: Device unsafe
rooted_warning.explanation: The operating system on your device seems to be modified (Rooted/Jailbreak). Because of this, the safety of your data cannot be guaranteed.
rooted_warning.explanation_environment: Yivi seems to be running in an emulator, inside a copy of the app made by another app, or on a device with a tool that can change other apps. Because of this, the safety of your data cannot be guaranteed.

secure_pin.title: Choose PIN
secure_pin.subtitle: A secure PIN has the following properties:

rules.must_not_asc_or_desc: Must not contain ascending nor descending keyboard patterns, like 12345
rules.not_abcab_nor_abcba: Must not contain the following keyboard patterns: abcba, abcab, like 12312, 12321, 13331
rules.must_contain_valid_subset: Must contain 5 adjacent numbers, that comply with the rules mentioned above

secure_pin.inline: This PIN is possibly not secure.
